title: Full-screen Hugging Face Spaces
question: How do I make a Hugging Face Space fill the window?
answer: A Space on huggingface.co already fills the window except for a header bar with its name and the App, Files and Community tabs. To lose that bar too, open the app on its own address, owner-name.hf.space, which the Embed this Space option shows. The usermods script on this page hides the header bar on Space pages so the app takes the whole window, and adds a small Show header button in the bottom corner to bring the bar back.
prompt: On Hugging Face Spaces, hide the header so the app fills the whole window.
details:
The script hides the page's header bar only while a running app (`iframe.space-iframe`) is on the page, so the Files and Community tabs look as before. The app frame then grows into the free space. The **Show header** button in the bottom-right corner toggles the bar; the setting is not remembered between pages.

The check loads a small Gradio demo Space and confirms the header is hidden and the app frame starts at the top of the window and fills it.

alternatives.title: Open the app directly
alternatives.body: Every Space app also runs on its own address, `https://<owner>-<space-name>.hf.space`. The three-dot menu on a Space page has **Embed this Space**, which shows that direct URL.

alternatives.title: Browser full screen
alternatives.body: F11 on Windows and Linux, or Control-Command-F on a Mac, hides the browser's own toolbars. The Space header stays.

check.baseline: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('header'); const f = document.querySelector('iframe.space-iframe'); return !!h && h.checkVisibility() && /hello_world/.test(h.innerText) && f.getBoundingClientRect().top >= 40; })()
check.expect: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('header'); const f = document.querySelector('iframe.space-iframe').getBoundingClientRect(); const b = document.querySelector('.um-space-toggle'); return !!h && /hello_world/.test(h.textContent) && !h.checkVisibility() && f.top === 0 && f.height >= innerHeight - 2 && !!b && b.checkVisibility(); })()
